description: South African Airways Voyager miles for a flight South African Airways operates, from the published base fare plus carrier-imposed fees in South African rand (ZAR, no taxes): 1 Voyager mile per R1.60, rounded down. Give the ZAR amount for the flight (Voyager pro-rates a ticket over its sectors). The class-of-service bonus and the Silver 25%, Gold 50% and Platinum 75% tier bonus are not calculated (not published as a rate on these miles); Silver, Gold and Platinum need 20,000, 45,000 and 95,000 tier miles in a calendar year. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Give the price in ZAR, not US dollars. Unofficial.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of South African Airways's own: united = United MileagePlus (creditStatus one of: General member, Premier Silver, Premier Gold, Premier Platinum, Premier 1K); aeroplan = Aeroplan (creditStatus one of: Aeroplan Member, 25K, 35K, 50K, 75K, Super Elite); flying-club = Flying Club (creditStatus one of: Red, Silver, Gold). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. Give the booking class letter as creditClass. Give the flights as creditFlights (one entry per flight with its great-circle miles). No price is needed with creditTo.

price.description: Base fare and carrier fees (ZAR) in ZAR. In rand: the published base fare plus carrier-imposed fees, without taxes. Type the amount, with R or ZAR before it if you like (R1,500). Required unless creditTo is given.
